meta.title: The Desert Treasure
meta.subtitle: 🏜 Rumors speak of a hidden fortune buried deep within Goldwind Desert.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: ❌ The Desert Intersection
scenes.narrative:
🌬 Wind sweeps across the cracked road beneath your boots.

Ahead lies an abandoned intersection marked by a broken wooden sign.

🏜 Left leads toward towering dunes.
🔥 Straight ahead, heat waves shimmer in the distance.
🪨 To the right, jagged rocks rise from the sand.

Somewhere out there lies the treasure.

scenes.title: 🏜 The Endless Dunes
scenes.narrative:
The dunes stretch endlessly beneath the burning sun.

🥵 Every step sinks into the sand.

Eventually, you spot a half-buried structure with a rusted ladder along its side.

scenes.title: 🌅 Above the Sands
scenes.narrative:
You climb carefully to the rooftop.

👁 From above, the desert stretches forever.

In the distance, you spot a faint oasis shimmer… or maybe a mirage.

scenes.title: 🏚 The Forgotten Outpost
scenes.narrative:
Dust covers the abandoned building.

📦 Broken crates and faded markings line the walls.

A worn map sits on a table beside a heavy metal door.

scenes.title: 🗺 The Map
scenes.narrative:
The map reveals a hidden chamber beneath the desert.

📍 According to the markings, the entrance lies beneath a false oasis.

scenes.title: 🎒 Supplies
scenes.narrative:
You search through the crates.

💧 Inside you find water, tools, and a flare gun.

It might save your life later.

scenes.title: 🤖 The Guardian
scenes.narrative:
The metal door creaks open.

👁 Inside lurks a twisted creature made of bone and machinery.

It notices you instantly.

scenes.title: 💨 Escape
scenes.narrative:
The flare erupts in blinding light.

🔥 The creature screeches and recoils.

You escape into the desert, heart pounding.

scenes.title: 🏝 The Mirage
scenes.narrative:
You walk toward the shimmering oasis.

The closer you get, the more it flickers.

Then it vanishes.

Beneath the sand sits a hidden hatch.

scenes.title: 💎 The Hidden Chamber
scenes.narrative:
You descend beneath the desert.

✨ Glowing crystals illuminate a vast underground chamber.

At its center rests a massive chest.

scenes.title: 🏛 The Balcony Vault
scenes.narrative:
You enter through the rooftop hatch and land on a hidden balcony.

Below sits a massive untouched chest.

scenes.title: ☀️ Lost to the Desert
scenes.narrative:
You continue wandering through the dunes.

💧 Your water runs out.

The endless desert eventually claims you.

scenes.title: ☠️ Too Slow
scenes.narrative:
You try to escape.

But the creature moves faster.

Everything goes dark.

scenes.title: ⚠️ The Trap
scenes.narrative:
As you step closer, the ground begins to shake.

🪨 The chamber collapses around you.

The treasure was never meant to leave the desert.

scenes.title: 💰 The Treasure of Goldwind
scenes.narrative:
You open the chest.

✨ Gold, gems, and ancient artifacts sparkle inside.

You found the legendary treasure.

Your name will be remembered.

scenes.title: 🪨 The Rocky Cliffs
scenes.narrative:
The rocky trail rises steeply above the desert.

Loose stones shift beneath your feet.

💀 Halfway up, you discover a skeleton clutching a journal.

scenes.title: 🕳 The Fall
scenes.narrative:
A loose rock slips beneath your foot.

You tumble into the canyon below.

🏜 The desert claims another explorer.
